title: Deep muscles of the palm (palmar)
attribution: 3D anatomy from Z-Anatomy, built on BodyParts3D (CC BY-SA). Rendered in Blender, with surface detail added by an image model.

rows: Flexor retinaculum and the tubercle of the trapezium.
Recurrent branch of the median nerve (C8, T1).
Opposes the thumb: draws the 1st metacarpal across the palm and rotates it medially.

structures.name: Opponens digiti minimi muscle
objects: Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.r

rows: Hook of the hamate and the flexor retinaculum.
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (C8, T1).
Draws the 5th metacarpal forward and rotates it, bringing the little finger toward the thumb.

structures.name: Oblique head of adductor pollicis muscle
prompts: Oblique head of adductor pollicis muscle

rows: Bases of the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals and the capitate.
Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (C8, T1).

structures.name: Transverse head of adductor pollicis muscle
prompts: Transverse head of adductor pollicis muscle

rows: Anterior surface of the shaft of the 3rd metacarpal.
Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (C8, T1).
Four muscles, each from the facing sides of two neighboring metacarpals.
Bases of the proximal phalanges and the extensor expansions of digits 2 to 4.
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (C8, T1).
Abduct the fingers away from the middle finger. Help flex the metacarpophalangeal joints and extend the interphalangeal joints.
hy: DAB and PAD: Dorsal interossei ABduct, Palmar interossei ADduct.

rows: Three muscles, from the palmar surfaces of metacarpals 2, 4, and 5, each on the side that faces the middle finger.
Bases of the proximal phalanges and the extensor expansions of digits 2, 4, and 5, on the side that faces the middle finger.
Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (C8, T1).
Adduct the index, ring, and little fingers toward the middle finger. Help flex the metacarpophalangeal joints and extend the interphalangeal joints.
